# Stability Summary for Nov 2024:

Starting with November, the Enterprise
Wireroom Platform Availability SLO results will
be based on the monthly performance report
provided from the SaaS vendor

There were 4 Major Incidents in November,
impacting payments processing delays and
delivery of financial reports to corporate and
commercial clients

There were 2 SLOs trending red and 12 SLOs
trending yellow for the month of November.
Path to green for those SLOs are being tracked
through assigned problem tickets and stability
forum.

Red SLOs:
- SCO 2.0 PSE Payment
- Enterprise File Highway
High Value Payments

targets.csvContent:
Incident, Date, Duration, Impact, Root Cause, Resolution, Next Steps
911-MI - Multiple channels and applications are experiencing issues with retrieving account balances and customer data, Nov 12 2024, 9D 10H 25M, Scotia Connect: Corporate commercial and small business customers were unable to perform account transfers between their accounts and e-transfers through Scotia Connect. Customer Initiated Transfers (Account to Account transfer): 1431 CIT failures impacting 596 clients (335 Commercial; 35 Corporate; 13 Concierge Plus; 213 Small Business) Total value of failed transfers: Approx. $633MM. eTransfer: 797 e-Transfer failures impacting 326 clients (2 Corporate; 111 Commercial; 213 Small Business) Total value of rejected transfers: Approx. $2MM. Bill Payments: 32 impacted payments affecting 19 clients (8 Commercial; 11 Small Business) Total value: Approx. $683000 Wires: 370 wire payments requiring DDA account updates were posted with a delay. Payment Services: TranXact - Realtime Payment and Request for Payment API customers were unable to process transactions due to system error. Trade Finance: Customers were intermittently unable to release letters of credit for payments to their accounts (Posting to the DDA accounts Loan etc.)., TBD - Trigger is the TSYS Conversion., A number of recovery steps and optimization changes were deployed to stabilize the impacted ecosystems, - Enhance real-time database performance monitoring and alerting system for early signs of contention. - Review and refine the incident management process to ensure faster response during critical outages. - Update secondary database server bringing up to par with the primary server and improve capacity threshold.
911-MI - Issues Sending and Receiving AFT Exchange Files and Some Cheque Processing Files to/from Financial Institutions, Nov 15 2024, 2H 22M, Some CAD/USD EFT Files missed the 09:30 ET Cut-off. 9 Central1 Credit Union (C1CU) interbank image exchange files were impacted 7 outbound files to C1CU valued at $700k had been held over for one business day. 2 inbound files from C1CU with a value of $4MM were received one business day late., Network - BNS Appliance, A Firewall Change (CHG0952890) was rolled back and the inbound and outbound files were received/sent and processed., Applications team to be involved in pre-testing for network changes Discuss the payment file delivery options with OFI’s in terms of a preapproved changes.
911-MI - Scotia Connect Online Unavailable, Nov 24 2024, 43M, 13 e-transfers were rejected., Application - Alerts/Monitoring, A Batch job causing database contention was stopped and data changes were rolled back to resolve the issue., Action items were combined with the those of the TSYS major incident.
911-MI - Unavailability of Scotia Connect 2.0, Nov 29 2024, 1H 42M, Corporate and commercial clients were unable to access account/product information or perform transfers and payments. Application teams deployed a workaround for Mexico by redirecting the users to the alternate platform (Scotia Online)., Infrastructure Capacity (Forecast / Demand management), Support teams increased the memory followed by a complete restart of the cloud application services., - Application team to identify the services that must remain active for the proper operation of the application additionally identify what can be disabled to reduce CPU/Memory usage. - Implement alerting to identify the organizational allocated memory consumption threshold.
